Appointments from Encanto Village take place at 6022 N 16th St, Phoenix, AZ 85016. Call 602-607-5686 if you need help selecting a service or planning a group visit. The salon is open Monday–Saturday 9:30 AM–7 PM and Sunday 10 AM–5 PM; available booking times may end earlier. Free on-site parking is available. Plan your visit · Acrylic / Dip / Hard Gel

Name the current enhancement before choosing a fill or removal.

An Encanto Village guest traveling to Element 16 should distinguish acrylic, dip powder, Builder Gel, hard product, and unknown outside work before selecting the appointment. An acrylic fill is not a universal maintenance category, and dip generally follows a soak-off and new-service path rather than a fill. Lifting, breaks, missing length, or a change of system can alter the work.
